inputSchema.title: RunsCancelRequest

outputSchema.title: RunsCancelResponse
outputSchema.description: Canonical run snapshot after a stop request, including command replay information.

state.description: Fresh cancellations return cancelling, ambiguous, or cancelled. An exact replay returns the current durable snapshot, which may have reconciled to completed or failed.

outputSchema.title: RunsCreateResponse
